title: blueberries
description: replaces the glow berries with the blue berries from the copper golem trailer
body:
this resource pack replaces glow berries with the blueberries from the trailer

I tried to recreate them as accurately as possible, you can see them ingame and in the trailer

![resourcepack](https://i.imgur.com/RHRVZcs.jpeg)

![intrailer](https://static.planetminecraft.com/files/image/minecraft/texture-pack/2025/109/18962110-image_l.webp)

i'm not gonna update the resource pack alot, but it supports most versions before the resource pack version and most likely after



you can use the textures for anything as long as you give credit
